lines.en: I drift over the dry grass without stirring a tip.
My body is light as mist.
I drift over the aetherwilt grass.

lines.zh: 草尖从我身体里穿过去。
lines.en: The grass tips pass through me.

lines.zh: 我往下压一点，又浮起来。
lines.en: I press down a little, then float up.
I follow the vapor in the low ground.
I drift over a marsh.
The water doesn't reflect me.
I drift half a circle around a tree.
The leaves rustle. I don't.
I head for wetter ground.
There's something I want there.
The damp air lifts me a foot higher.
I can see clearly from this height.
I settle back onto the grass.
I drift ahead and don't look back.
I hover over the grass, still.
My outline isn't very clear.
The wind blows and I spread a little.
Then gather again.
I'm drawing the damp from the ground.
The grass beneath me slowly dries.
The grass curls the moment it touches me.
But I can't stop either.
I drift to another spot.
The grass there is still green.
I rest there a while.
A bug flies through me.
I hang over the branch, drawing water slowly.
But I felt it.
I rise slowly.
I thin out into a pale haze.
I bring my outline right up to your eyes.
I'm here, above the grass.
Look up and you'll see.
I haven't much of a shape.
There's no need at all to fear.
I don't eat living things.
I only drink the water in the air.
You have a lot of it.
There's plenty of vapor on you.
May I come a little closer?
You're not saying anything, so I'll take that as yes.
I drift over.
Half of me scattered.
Gathering back, slowly.
I've thinned a lot.
There's vapor on your hands.
That little bit is me.
I drift lower.
The grass holds me.
Not really.
A little of me is still in the mist.
Just less clear.
What's in your hand is wet.
I drift down from above.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的手背飘过去。
lines.en: I drift across the back of your hand.
It's starting to dry.
I've drawn a little off.

lines.zh: 水汽太薄，我只吸到一点。
lines.en: The moisture is thin; I draw only a little.
You don't have to give it all.
A little is fine.
I reach a hand down.
It passes through yours.
I forgot that again.

lines.zh: 我的指尖从你掌心穿过。
lines.en: My fingertips pass through your palm.
All I can do is come near.
That's good enough.
I drift back onto the grass.
The grass dries beneath me.
You pass into my body.
Cold and clammy, isn't it.

lines.zh: 你退出去，衣服上带着湿。
lines.en: You step out with damp on your clothes.

lines.zh: 我身上的湿气，蹭到你身上了。
lines.en: The damp off me has rubbed onto you.
I scatter and gather.
Neither of us broke.

lines.zh: 我本来也没什么可坏的。
lines.en: There isn't much of me to break.
I float higher.
That way we can't collide.
I give up the air and let you pass.
There's no pairing in the mist.

lines.zh: 水汽多的时候，我们就多。
lines.en: When there's more vapor, there are more of us.

lines.zh: 雾浓的早晨，能看见很多。
lines.en: On foggy mornings you can see many.
In the aetherwilt, we drift.
We just drift.
Close enough, and we merge into one.
We merge, then part.

lines.zh: 分开以后，分不清谁是谁。
lines.en: Afterward, you can't tell which is which.
That's fine by me.
You're human. You wouldn't understand.

lines.zh: 露水在我身下一点点干。
lines.en: Beneath me the dew dries a little at a time.
I've tried many times.

lines.zh: 手穿过去，什么也没抓到。
lines.en: My hand passes through and grasps nothing.
I can only draw off a little water.
I draw the dew from the leaves.
The leaves dry and curl.
I don't mean it harm.
But I need water.
Head down, letting the wind pass.
And draw from the water's surface.
The mist is thick over there.
Something's in it.
That shape is alive.
A void floater drifts very slowly.
I circle once and see clearly.
We stare at each other across the marsh.

lines.zh: 以太沼泽上，我不落下来。
lines.en: Over the aether swamp, I never descend.
I have nothing to give.
And nothing to take.
Neither of us moves; we just hold.
I follow that patch of vapor.
It's moving downhill.
The vapor is thickest low down.
I drift down too.
There's a layer of grass between us.
I pass through it.
The vapor is right below.
I come close and it scatters.
It was never solid.
We press together.
I press down as a whole cloud.
My whole cloud misses.
I haven't much force to begin with.

lines.zh: 我撞在它身上，它打了个冷颤。
lines.en: I hit it and it shivers.
It backs away.
I follow along the grass.
I reach to grab it.

lines.zh: 我整团压上去，只带点凉。
lines.en: I press my whole body down; all it brings is chill.

lines.zh: 沉下去又浮上来，我还在。
lines.en: I sank and rose again. Still here.
It looks very tired. I move aside.
I condense out of a patch of mist.
This is the aetherswamp.
Water and grass all around below me.
I float, a little above the grass.
My body isn't steady yet.
When the wind comes I scatter.
Scattered, then gathered again.
It takes a few times to hold.
There's plenty of vapor here.

lines.zh: 雾从我身上过，我留一点。
lines.en: The mist passes through and I keep a little.

lines.zh: 火把水汽烤干了，我缩小了。
lines.en: Fire dries the vapor and I shrink.

lines.zh: 我往下落，落得比想的快。
lines.en: I fall faster than I expected.

lines.zh: 水把我吸进去，我化在里面。
lines.en: Water draws me in and I dissolve.
The blast blows the mist apart.
An arrow goes through and leaves a hole.

lines.zh: 一道光把水汽凝成了水。
lines.en: A light condenses the vapor into water.
Too dry here. I'm nearly gone.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我亮了一下就没了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I flash and vanish.

lines.zh: 虚空的风把我吹散了一半。
lines.en: The void wind scatters half of me.
